title: 100 Naked Girls on a Chair

description.main: One hundred women from Riga photographed naked on the same chair, from the same camera position, one to a page. Ralf Vulis's black-and-white photobook was published by Edition Reuss, Munich, in 2001, with a foreword in four languages.
description.extended:
Ralf Vulis photographed one hundred women from Riga naked on the same chair, from the same camera position, and Edition Reuss published the result as a photobook in 2001.

Each sitter has a page of her own. The frame is always the same portrait format, cropped from the legs of the chair to the top of her head, with no props and no change of set-up. The models range from young to middle-aged, and the repeated framing makes the differences between bodies, postures and expressions the subject. The photographs are in black and white. The book is unpaginated, about 114 pages at 29 by 20.5 centimetres, in pink boards under a jacket that repeats one frame as a grid. A short foreword appears in German, English, French and Italian, translated by Howard Fine, Sophie Vieillard and Fiorella Palini.

Vulis is a Latvian photographer who works in Riga. This was his fourth title with the Munich publisher Edition Reuss, after Crazy Sexy Girls (1999), Sex, Kitsch, Girls and Fun and Sexy Sports (2000). All four use the same pool of local models and the same unglamorous, good-humoured register. Where the earlier books were loose compilations, this one holds to a single rule throughout and reads as a serial portrait project as much as a glamour book.
description.artist_bio: Ralf Vulis (b. c. 1950 per GND) is a Latvian photographer and graphic artist based in Riga whose nude and erotic photobooks were published by Edition Reuss, Munich, between 1999 and 2001: Crazy Sexy Girls (1999), Sex, Kitsch, Girls and Fun, Sexy Sports: Maximal Crazy Girls (2000) and 100 Naked Girls on a Chair (2001).
